operators.customDisplayName: Sample first/last 3 rows of data/wildfire/input/Fire_Weather_Data_2002-2014_2016.csv to inspect columns (cause and acres) and data quality

operatorProperties.code:
def process(fire) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = fire.copy()
    # Focus on fires impacting >100 acres. Dataset has indicator gt_100 (1=yes)
    df = df[df['gt_100'] == 1]

    # Normalize cause to Lightning vs Human.
    # Observed cause codes include 'L' (Lightning) and others like 'H' (Human), 'U' (Unknown).
    cause = df['cause'].astype('string').str.strip().str.upper()
    mapped = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=df.index, dtype='string')
    mapped[cause.eq('L')] = 'Lightning'
    mapped[cause.eq('H')] = 'Human'

    # Keep only Lightning/Human for comparison
    df2 = pd.DataFrame({'cause_group': mapped}).dropna()
    out = df2.value_counts().reset_index(name='fires_gt100')
    return out.sort_values('fires_gt100', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: Filter to gt_100==1 (fires >100 acres), map cause codes to Lightning vs Human (L/H), count fires per group
